exposure: Day of blastocyst freezing (Day 5 vs Day 6)
outcome: Incidence of small for gestational age (SGA)
Incidence of large for gestational age (LGA)
cohort: 17,127 singleton newborns from single frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycles between January 2011 and January 2020.
finding: Neonatal birth weight and incidence of LGA, SGA, LBW, and macrosomia were similar between infants born from blastocysts frozen on day 5 versus day 6.
